defect: destination reset release is generated by a register in another clock domain
rationale: The destination request register is asynchronously released by src_release_q, whose transitions are clocked by unrelated clk_src rather than synchronized into clk_dst.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the request/acknowledge domain pair to one source release register and one destination consumer.

mutation.description: Used the source-domain release register directly as the destination-domain asynchronous reset.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: clk_dst reset is a clk_src flop output released without synchronisation to clk_dst.
